tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Permeta launches FERC.ai to let users search the FERC public record through Claude, Copilot and ChatGPT with source citations. Confirmed by The Joplin Globe.
Google has released Gemini 4 Argon. Reported by The Verge.
Anthropic will reveal Q3 financials ahead of a possible 2 trillion dollar IPO, with revenue estimates up to 100 billion dollars. Still open, per CNBC.
Co-op uses artificial intelligence to monitor staff calls, sparking worker outrage and new California laws. Confirmed by The Guardian.
Inside Real Estate launches BoldTrail MCP to let agents use artificial intelligence in real estate workflows via ChatGPT and Claude. Reported by PR Newswire.
Free every hour.
